title: The TOSS 5 /etc/gshadow file must be owned by root.
check_content:
Verify the ownership of the "/etc/gshadow" file using the following command:

$ sudo stat -c "%U %n" /etc/gshadow 

root /etc/gshadow 

If "/etc/gshadow" file does not have an owner of "root", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Change the owner of the file /etc/gshadow to root using the following command:

$ sudo chown root /etc/gshadow
VulnDiscussion: The "/etc/gshadow" file contains group password hashes. Protecting this file is critical for system security.
